title: Information Architect
summary: Architect responsible for information models that represent governed meaning as paradigm-independent structures.
body_markdown:
# Information Architect

## Purpose

Bridge meaning and data structures.

## Responsibilities

- Design and maintain [[Information Model|information models]].
- State information-level history and quality requirements.
- Ensure [[Concept-to-Model Traceability]].

## Decision Rights

Information model level lead approver; owner sign-off for governed concepts.

## Inputs

Semantic model; requirements.

## Outputs

Information models; traceability links.

## Required Competencies

Information modeling (UML/ER); semantics.

## Escalation Paths

Semantic gaps → [[Semantic Architect]]; realization conflicts → [[Data Architect]].

## Related Governance Processes

- [[Decision Rights Model]]
- [[Architecture Change Process]]
- [[Governance Lifecycle]]
